summary: This trace reveals a field service work order audit task that combines: (1) multi-source reconciliation (registry, approvals, request documents), (2) alias/name resolution beyond simple fuzzy matching, and (3) work order state validation (active vs closed). The existing multi-source-reconciliation skill covers the core pattern but misses two critical extensions: (1) alias matching where contractors have multiple registered names, and (2) status/state checks on reference records. The agent successfully completed the audit but the skill library should capture these extensions explicitly. I'm updating the existing multi-source-reconciliation skill to include alias handling and stateful validation patterns.
